entries.femaleVariant: V. You came. I was expecting a polite refusal and a malware scan.
entries.maleVariant: V. You came. I was expecting a polite refusal and a malware scan.

entries.femaleVariant: Already ran the scan. You're still pending.
entries.maleVariant: Already ran the scan. You're still pending.

entries.femaleVariant: Somebody stole Heartbreaker Protocol. I built it to break emotional-conditioning loops. The Claws turned it into a weapon. Now they're selling it.
entries.maleVariant: Somebody stole Heartbreaker Protocol. I built it to break emotional-conditioning loops. The Claws turned it into a weapon. Now they're selling it.

entries.femaleVariant: Heartbreaker. That supposed to make me feel better?
entries.maleVariant: Heartbreaker. That supposed to make me feel better?

entries.femaleVariant: The original interrupts conditioning signals. Gives people a window to say no. Theirs keeps the signal screaming until the nervous system folds.
entries.maleVariant: The original interrupts conditioning signals. Gives people a window to say no. Theirs keeps the signal screaming until the nervous system folds.

entries.femaleVariant: Their build has the only live signing key. Burn it and I can't revoke the copies. Recover first. Patch second. Dramatic explosions a distant third.
entries.maleVariant: Their build has the only live signing key. Burn it and I can't revoke the copies. Recover first. Patch second. Dramatic explosions a distant third.

entries.femaleVariant: You always flirt in your bug reports?
entries.maleVariant: You always flirt in your bug reports?

entries.femaleVariant: Only the critical ones. Low-priority tickets get a tasteful wink.
entries.maleVariant: Only the critical ones. Low-priority tickets get a tasteful wink.

entries.femaleVariant: I'll get your code. Send me the route.
entries.maleVariant: I'll get your code. Send me the route.

entries.femaleVariant: Three Claws, two access points. Recover my code and its signing key from the first. Then use the second to shut down the stolen copies. Keep both boxes intact.
entries.maleVariant: Three Claws, two access points. Recover my code and its signing key from the first. Then use the second to shut down the stolen copies. Keep both boxes intact.

entries.femaleVariant: And if you see little black bows in the interface, those are mine. Extremely important diagnostic equipment.
entries.maleVariant: And if you see little black bows in the interface, those are mine. Extremely important diagnostic equipment.

entries.femaleVariant: Got something else to finish. Keep the location.
entries.maleVariant: Got something else to finish. Keep the location.

entries.femaleVariant: I'll be here. Pretending this is a normal amount of anxiety.
entries.maleVariant: I'll be here. Pretending this is a normal amount of anxiety.
